text: Johor Corporation (JCorp) is a statutory body established under Johor Corporation Enactment No. 4 of 1968, whose Board of Directors is chaired ex officio by the Chief Minister of Johor.

source.name: BIX Malaysia: Principal terms and conditions of Johor Corporation's RM3.5 billion Sukuk Wakalah programme
source.quote: Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Issuer shall be held by a person for the time being holding the office of the Chief Minister of Johor
source.note: The terms also state JCorp is 'a statutory body incorporated under Johor Corporation Enactment No. 4, 1968 ... as a development agency and public enterprise'.

additionalSources.name: Johor Corporation (JCorp): Who We Are
additionalSources.quote: Johor Corporation (JCorp) is Johor's principal state development institution
